result.summary: The white team attacks the goal on the left, while the dark kit team defends, with their goalkeeper wearing bright yellow. A direct free kick is awarded centrally outside the penalty area. The taker strikes the dead ball cleanly over the defensive wall into the upper section of the net for a goal.

observations.title: Set piece alignment
observations.body: The defending team lines up a three-man wall near the penalty area to contest the central free kick. Attackers in white position themselves both out wide and inside the channel, while a single taker in white sets up directly behind the ball.

observations.title: Direct strike on goal
observations.body: The set-piece taker approaches with a deliberate run-up and strikes the stationary ball with the right foot. The flight trajectory carries over the jumping wall directly toward the goal frame.

observations.title: Goal converted
observations.body: The strike eludes the reaching goalkeeper and enters the top of the net. The taker turns toward the touchline to celebrate with teammates as the substitute bench reacts.
